legend.tebra: Value is authored in the Tebra theme (paletteValues.ts / typography.ts / *Overrides). Canonical.
legend.mui-substrate: Value is MUI's own default, surfacing because the Tebra theme never specifies it. Real, but not designed.
legend.mixed: Tebra authored part of the rule; MUI supplies the rest.

temporalFaultLine.evidence: CHANGELOG 0.6.1 (2023-10-19) removed oldKareoOverrides/{ButtonOverrides,ButtonGroupOverrides} and palette/oldKareoPaletteValues but explicitly kept Button and DataGrid on oldPaletteValues. 0.7.0 (2023-10-31) migrated them and deleted oldPaletteValues and the old theme.
temporalFaultLine.storybookEvidence: CHANGELOG 0.11.0 'Fixed: Updated StorybookDecorator to load Tebra theme in all stories.' Before this date Storybook rendered stock Material.
temporalFaultLine.conclusion: paletteValues.ts, typography.ts and ButtonOverrides.ts are all post-process and canonical. AutocompleteOverrides.tsx (authored 0.5.4, 2023-09-28) and TextFieldOverrides.tsx are pre-process survivors: their colors ride the palette rename but their geometry was never specified and remains raw MUI.
